title: Triage Queue — Priority Queue Manager
description: Build a terminal Python priority queue manager for an emergency unit: model patients with triage levels (1–3), implement enqueue, dequeue, peek, list_queue, and stats, build a CLI menu, and document your data-structure choice and concurrent-mutation strategy using only the Python standard library.
